title: fix: route MCP generation fetches publicly
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Cloudflare’s `global_fetch_strictly_public` compatibility flag to the hosted MCP Worker.
- Prevents nested prompt-agent MCP tools from receiving Cloudflare 522 responses when they call Gen.
- Keeps the existing MCP API, authentication, and billing flow unchanged.

Tests:
- `npm test` in `apps/mcp` (7/7)
- `npm run check` in `apps/mcp` (Wrangler dry-run)

gist.headline: The tools can reach Gen
gist.blurb: A small Cloudflare switch moved into place, and nested prompt-agent tools can once again talk to Gen without wandering into a 522 fog bank.
gist.summary: Enabled Cloudflare’s global_fetch_strictly_public compatibility flag for the hosted MCP Worker, preventing nested prompt-agent MCP tools from receiving 522 errors when calling Gen.
gist.impact: MCP agents using nested generation tools can reliably reach Gen while the existing MCP API, authentication, and billing flow stay exactly as they are.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny explorer with a weatherproof courier hat guiding a friendly CRT Monitor Robot across a clear public bridge from an MCP tool shed to a glowing Gen terminal. A previously foggy cloud barrier has opened into a safe route, with code-plants and flowers growing beside the connection to represent reliable nested tool calls.
